name: Evergreen Valley College Dual Enrollment and CCAP
what_you_do: You can take free college classes while in high school. You can pick open classes (up to 11 units, 7 in summer), or take a set of college classes taught at a partner high school (up to 15 units a semester).
who_can_apply: California students without a high school diploma or GED, with approval from your school counselor or principal. Adult school students in GED programs can also join.
pay_detail: No enrollment fees for dual enrollment students; material fees are waived for CCAP students only
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Submit the dual enrollment application, get your high school counselor or principal to approve, then enroll. Counseling: mycounselor@evc.edu, 408-270-6475.
notes: CCAP classes are closed cohort classes held at partner high schools, so ask your school if it has an agreement. The page does not state a grade or age rule. Textbook costs for non-CCAP students are not stated.
